item.title: Photos: Spain and France battle record wildfires

item.title: Netanyahu to meet Trump in a first encounter since the Iran war began
item.description: The meeting comes as both face pressures at home. Netanyahu is up for reelection, embattled in part due to his deteriorating relationship with Trump. Trump is under pressure to end an unpopular war.
